quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle other than a bus in a bus stop, or a taxicab in a taxicab stand, when such stop or stand has been officially designated and appropriately signed, except that the driver of a passenger vehicle may temporarily stop there and for the purpose of and while actually engaged in expeditiously loading or unloading of passengers when such stopping does not interfere with any bus or taxicab waiting to enter or about to enter such zone.

activation.source_clause: when such stop or stand has been officially designated and appropriately signed

obligation.source_clause: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle other than a bus in a bus stop, or a taxicab in a taxicab stand

judgment_calls_needed.note: Stand and sign status need original site and authority review.
Duration alone does not establish the legal term.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: actually engaged in expeditiously loading or unloading of passengers
judgment_calls_needed.note: Observed activity and expedience need independent review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: does not interfere with any bus or taxicab waiting to enter or about to enter such zone
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original access and entrant observations do not themselves decide interference.
